# BotNira

> BotNira is an AI receptionist & sales-assistant platform that answers business calls, WhatsApp messages, web chats, SMS and emails 24/7. It books appointments, qualifies leads and runs outbound sales campaigns — in 90+ languages.

BotNira is built for service businesses, clinics, salons, immigration consultants, restaurants, agencies, real-estate teams and B2B sales teams. It brings five customer channels (Voice / WhatsApp / Web chat / SMS / Email) into one inbox and one AI that learns the business from a short description and FAQs.

Pricing (USD/month, + 13% HST): Basic $29 (chat-only), Starter $49, Growth $149 (includes AI Sales Assistant), Pro $399 (includes AI Sales Assistant). Plans hard-stop at their limits so there are no surprise bills. 5-day free trial, no credit card.

Contact:
